name: Praia da Ursa
description: Sea stacks and black sand under the cliffs just north of Cabo da Roca, the westernmost point of mainland Europe. The descent is a steep unmade path with a rope in one section, which is the only reason it isn't rammed.
getting: Drive to Cabo da Roca from Sintra, then the unmarked pull-in about 1km north. Twenty minutes down, thirty-five back up. Not at high tide, and not in the dark.
